findings.current_code: <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onMenuClick} className="mt-[var(--bd-space-xs)] h-9 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-[var(--bd-radius-md)] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))/0.45] text-[hsl(var(--bd-text))/0.8] hover:bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))] active:scale-95 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[hsl(var(--bd-focus-ring))]" ...>
findings.violation: Background uses semi-transparent surface-muted (bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))/0.45]) instead of bg-transparent. Missing explicit border (border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700). Uses rounded-[var(--bd-radius-md)] instead of rounded-lg. Hover state uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))] instead of hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800. Missing transition-colors class. Icon uses custom SidebarToggleIcon (size-5) with strokeWidth={2} instead of a standard hamburger icon at w-5 h-5.

findings.current_code: <button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} className="absolute right-4 top-4 grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground" aria-label="Close navigation menu">
findings.violation: Close button in sidebar uses rounded-full and bg-muted instead of bg-transparent with border. Missing border, hover state, and transition-colors. This is a close button but follows the same trigger pattern.

findings.current_code: data-[size=default]:h-[16.6px] data-[size=default]:w-[28px] data-[size=sm]:h-[14px] data-[size=sm]:w-[24px] ... data-[state=checked]:bg-[hsl(var(--bd-brand))] data-[state=unchecked]:bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))]
findings.violation: Dimensions do not match target. Default size is w-[28px] h-[16.6px] instead of target w-11 (44px) h-6 (24px). Track off-state uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))] (custom token) instead of bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700. On-state uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-brand))] instead of bg-primary-600 dark:bg-primary-500. Thumb size is 3.5 (14px) instead of target w-5 h-5 (20px). Thumb uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-card-bg))] instead of bg-white. Translate on checked is translate-x-[calc(100%-2px)] instead of translate-x-5.

findings.current_code: className="fixed bottom-[94px] right-4 z-50 grid h-14 w-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-transparent bg-[hsl(var(--bd-fab-bg))] text-[hsl(var(--bd-fab-text))] shadow-lg transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 md:hidden"
findings.violation: Shape uses rounded-2xl instead of target rounded-full. Background uses custom token bg-[hsl(var(--bd-fab-bg))] instead of bg-primary-600 dark:bg-primary-500. Missing dark mode shadow variant (shadow-lg shadow-black/20). Icon size is h-7 w-7 instead of target h-5 h-5 or h-6 w-6. Icon stroke-width is stroke-[2.4] instead of default Lucide stroke. No responsive size difference (always h-14 w-14 on mobile, target says w-12 h-12 mobile / w-14 h-14 desktop).

findings.current_code: <button ... className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-[hsl(var(--bd-border))] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-card-bg))] text-[hsl(var(--bd-text-muted))] hover:bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface-muted))] hover:text-[hsl(var(--bd-text))] transition-colors duration-150 disabled:opacity-50" style={{ minWidth: '44px', minHeight: '44px', width: '36px', height: '36px' }}>
findings.violation: Container uses rounded-xl instead of target rounded-md. Uses inline style for dimensions (36x36) instead of Tailwind classes. Background uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-card-bg))] instead of transparent (target has no explicit bg, only hover). Hover uses custom tokens instead of hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800. Missing p-2 padding class. Icon is w-4 h-4 (correct) but missing explicit strokeWidth={1.75}.

findings.current_code: <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={toggle} className="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 text-foreground/80 hover:bg-muted active:scale-95" ...><Search className="h-5 w-5" />
findings.violation: Container is h-10 w-10 (oversized for a utility icon). Uses rounded-xl instead of target rounded-md. Background uses bg-muted/50 instead of transparent. Icon is h-5 w-5 instead of target h-4 w-4. Text color uses text-foreground/80 instead of text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400. Hover uses bg-muted instead of hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800.

findings.current_code: ring-1 ring-[hsl(var(--bd-card-border))]
findings.violation: Card uses ring-1 ring-[hsl(var(--bd-card-border))] instead of target border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800. Missing shadow-sm for light mode and shadow-sm shadow-black/10 for dark mode. Uses custom CSS variable token instead of standard Tailwind color classes.

findings.current_code: border border-[hsl(var(--bd-border))] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface))] ... shadow-sm md:shadow-none md:rounded-[var(--bd-radius-md)] md:border-x-0 md:border-t-0
findings.violation: Mobile uses border border-[hsl(var(--bd-border))] (custom token, not slate-200/slate-800). Desktop removes horizontal and top borders (md:border-x-0 md:border-t-0) creating inconsistency. Shadow is shadow-sm on mobile but md:shadow-none on desktop. Missing dark mode shadow variant (shadow-sm shadow-black/10).

findings.current_code: className="fixed inset-0 isolate z-[250] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-overlay-scrim))] duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs ..."
findings.violation: Backdrop uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-overlay-scrim))] which resolves to hsl(222 47% 11% / 0.4) — a dark blue at 40% opacity instead of target bg-black/50 dark:bg-black/70. Uses duration-100 instead of target transition-opacity duration-200. No separate dark mode opacity value defined (single token for both modes).

findings.current_code: className="fixed inset-0 z-[250] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-overlay-scrim))] duration-100 ..."
findings.violation: Same as dialog: backdrop uses bg-[hsl(var(--bd-overlay-scrim))] (hsl(222 47% 11% / 0.4)) instead of target bg-black/50 dark:bg-black/70. Uses duration-100 instead of target transition-opacity duration-200. No dark mode differentiation.

findings.current_code: className="surface-overlay-strong fixed inset-0 z-50 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs ..."
findings.violation: Uses a custom CSS class 'surface-overlay-strong' instead of explicit bg-black/50 dark:bg-black/70. Duration is 100ms instead of target 200ms. Missing transition-opacity class. Z-index is z-50 while dialog/sheet use z-[250] (inconsistency).

findings.current_code: focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/30
findings.violation: Focus ring uses focus-visible:ring-ring/30 (30% opacity of generic ring color) instead of target focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-white dark:focus:ring-offset-slate-950. Missing ring-offset entirely. Uses focus-visible: prefix (acceptable) but ring color is generic 'ring' token at 30% opacity instead of primary-500.

findings.current_code: focus-visible:border-[hsl(var(--bd-brand))] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[hsl(var(--bd-brand))/15]
findings.violation: Focus ring uses brand color at 15% opacity instead of target focus:ring-primary-500. Missing focus:ring-offset-2 and focus:ring-offset-white dark:focus:ring-offset-slate-950.

findings.current_code: className="rounded-[var(--bd-radius-lg)] border border-[hsl(var(--bd-border)_/_0.8)] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-surface)_/_0.95)] px-[var(--bd-space-md)] py-[var(--bd-space-sm)] shadow-sm"
findings.violation: No fixed height defined. Header uses padding-based sizing (py-[var(--bd-space-sm)]) instead of a fixed h-14. Height varies based on content rather than being consistent at 56px (h-14) across all pages.

findings.current_code: className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-40 border-t border-[hsl(var(--bd-border))] bg-[hsl(var(--bd-layout-nav)/0.95)] backdrop-blur-xl" ... <div className="grid h-[64px] w-full grid-cols-5 ...">
findings.violation: Bottom nav uses h-[64px] which is not h-14 (56px). While this is a bottom nav not a top header, it creates inconsistency with the target h-14 standard for navigation bars.

findings.current_code: className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all duration-300 md:hidden"
findings.violation: Search overlay uses bg-background/60 (60% of background color) instead of target bg-black/50 dark:bg-black/70. Duration is 300ms instead of target 200ms. Uses transition-all instead of transition-opacity.

findings.current_code: className="mb-4 rounded-[22px] border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/60 p-4 shadow-sm"
findings.violation: Sync recovery banner uses hardcoded Tailwind color classes (border-amber-200, bg-amber-50/60) instead of design token variables. Does not follow the card border target of border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800. No dark mode variant defined — will appear as light amber in dark mode.
Uses hardcoded hex color text-[#16a34a] and rgba value instead of design token variables. No dark mode variant.

findings.current_code: className="relative border-b border-[var(--bd-border-soft)] bg-[var(--bd-surface)] px-0 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-[#fdfcfb]"
findings.violation: Hover state uses hardcoded hex color hover:bg-[#fdfcfb] instead of a design token. No dark mode variant for hover — will show a near-white background in dark mode.

findings.current_code: <Switch ... className="mt-1 border border-[var(--notification-border)] bg-[var(--notification-bg)] data-[state=checked]:border-[var(--notification-active-bg)] data-[state=checked]:bg-[var(--notification-active-bg)] [&>span]:bg-[var(--notification-bg)]" />
findings.violation: Switch overrides use notification-specific CSS variables (--notification-border, --notification-bg, --notification-active-bg) instead of the unified switch token system. Thumb color is overridden to notification-bg instead of white. These custom tokens may not align with the target switch colors.
